fields.name: button-color
fields.label: Button colour
fields.description: Background of buttons, as a colour code such as #513F77. Empty: the site's own buttons.

validation.customErrorMsg: Use a colour code such as #513F77.

fields.name: button-text-color
fields.label: Button text colour
fields.description: Text on buttons, such as #FFFFFF. Empty: white or black, whichever reads better. A pair below 4.5:1 contrast isn't used.

validation.customErrorMsg: Use a colour code such as #FFFFFF.

fields.name: link-color
fields.label: Link colour
fields.description: Text links, such as #167183. Needs 4.5:1 contrast on white; otherwise the site's own colour stays.

validation.customErrorMsg: Use a colour code such as #167183.

fields.name: accent-color
fields.label: Accent colour
fields.description: The coloured bar above the header and accent headings, such as #7845C1. Needs 3:1 contrast on white.

validation.customErrorMsg: Use a colour code such as #7845C1.
